title: helianthemum lippii var. rosmarinifolium
intro: Helianthemum lippii var. rosmarinifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a shrubby perennial plant that belongs to the family Cistaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to protect against infections and ease muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, and phenolic acids, such as rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
